description: This file contains utility functions for error normalization and handling within a JavaScript/Frontend web application, specifically exporting functions normalizeError and handleApiError.

methods.name: normalizeError(err)
methods.description: Normalizes various types of error objects (HTTP errors, fetch errors, app errors) into a consistent shape with message, status, code, and details.
